title: ochna nervosa
intro: Ochna nervosa, commonly known as the Mickey Mouse plant due to its distinctive red berries, is a plant species in the family Ochnaceae. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its potential to support digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Ochna nervosa are attributed to its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-hyperlipidemic properties, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified in the plant's leaves, stems, and roots.
